post.summary: Registers a new account as either an Organiser or a Participant.
post.description:
Public endpoint. The password is hashed (PBKDF2 + random salt) before it is stored
and is never returned. Email addresses must be unique.

requestBody.description: FullName, Email, Password (min 8 chars), Role ("Organiser" or "Participant") and optional ContactNumber.

201.description: Account created. Returns the new user profile (no password).

400.description: A field is missing or invalid (for example an unknown role).

409.description: That email address is already registered.

post.summary: Logs in and starts a session that remembers the user's id and role.
post.description:
Public endpoint. On success a session cookie is issued; every later request made with
that cookie is treated as logged in, with the stored role (Organiser or Participant).

200.description: Login successful. Returns the user id, name and role.

post.summary: Logs out and destroys the current session.

put.description: Organisers only, and only for categories that belong to their own events.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the category belongs to a different Organiser's event.

delete.description: Organisers only, for their own events. A category that already has enrolments cannot be deleted.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the category belongs to a different Organiser's event.

409.description: The category has enrolments and cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant into a category and issues a bib number.
post.description:
Participants only. The enrolment records the link between the Participant, the category and
(through the category) the event. The event must be "Open", the category must not be full,
and a Participant cannot enrol in the same category twice.

201.description: The enrolment, including the bib number.

400.description: The event is not open for enrolment, or the category is full.

403.description: The logged-in user is not a Participant.

409.description: The Participant is already enrolled in this category.

delete.description:
The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may cancel it.
The record is kept with status "Cancelled" so results and payments stay traceable.

403.description: The enrolment belongs to someone else's registration and a different Organiser's event.

get.summary: Returns the result for one enrolment.
get.description: The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may view it.

403.description: The enrolment is not yours and the event is not yours.

404.description: No such enrolment, or no result has been recorded yet.

post.summary: Records a payment for an enrolment.
post.description:
Participants only, for their own enrolments. The amount must equal the category's entry fee.
A successful payment confirms the enrolment. (No real payment gateway is called; this is a simulation.)

requestBody.description: Amount and PaymentMethod (Card, EFT or Cash).

400.description: Invalid fields, or the amount does not match the entry fee.

403.description: Not a Participant, or the enrolment belongs to someone else.

409.description: The enrolment is cancelled or has already been paid.

get.summary: Returns the payment history of an enrolment.
get.description: The Participant who owns the enrolment, or the Organiser of the event, may view it.

403.description: The enrolment is not yours and the event is not yours.

post.summary: Creates a new event owned by the logged-in Organiser.
post.description: Organisers only. The event is linked to the logged-in Organiser automatically.

requestBody.description: EventName, EventDate, Location, DistanceKM, EventType (Run/Walk/Cycle), optional Description and Status.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

403.description: The logged-in user is not an Organiser.

get.summary: Lists all events, optionally filtered by status or event type.
get.description: Public: no login required. Example: GET /api/events?status=Open&eventType=Run

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional: Planned, Open, Closed, Completed or Cancelled.

200.description: Array of events (empty if none match).

get.summary: Returns one event, including its categories.

put.description: Organisers only, and only for events they own.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the event belongs to a different Organiser.

delete.summary: Deletes an event and its categories.
delete.description:
Organisers only, and only for events they own. An event that already has enrolments
cannot be deleted (this protects Participants' records); set its status to "Cancelled" instead.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the event belongs to a different Organiser.

409.description: The event has enrolments and cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Adds a category (for example "10km" or "Under 20") to an event.
post.description: Organisers only, and only for events they own.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the event belongs to a different Organiser.

get.summary: Lists the categories of an event.
Lists every enrolment for an event.
get.description: Organisers only, and only for events they own.

200.description: Array of enrolments with participant and category details.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the event belongs to a different Organiser.

get.summary: Returns the results (leaderboard) for an event, ordered by finishing position.
get.description: Public: no login required. Entries without a position are listed last.

post.summary: Captures (or updates) the finish time and position for an enrolment.
post.description:
Organisers only, and only for enrolments in events they own. If a result already exists for the
enrolment it is updated (200) instead of creating a duplicate (201). A "Finished" result must include
both FinishTime and Position.

requestBody.description: EnrolmentID, FinishTime (hh:mm:ss), Position and Status (Not Started, Finished, DNF, DSQ).

400.description: Invalid fields, or a Finished result is missing its time or position.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or the enrolment is in a different Organiser's event.

get.summary: Returns the profile of the logged-in user.
get.description: Requires login (any role). A user can only ever see their own profile.

put.summary: Updates the logged-in user's name and contact number.
put.description: Requires login (any role). Email and role cannot be changed here.

400.description: A field is missing or too long.

get.summary: Lists all enrolments belonging to the logged-in Participant.

200.description: Array of enrolments, including event and category names.

403.description: The logged-in user is not a Participant.

ErrorResponse.description: Consistent error body used for 401, 403, 404, 409 and custom 400 responses.

status.description: Optional. Planned, Open, Closed, Completed or Cancelled. Defaults to Planned.
Not Started, Finished, DNF or DSQ.

UserDto.description: Safe view of a user. The password hash is never returned.
